name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-02-05, at wavelengths from 0.96 to 4.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
